🎬: Family Guy Halloween Special (2026)

When Halloween arrives in Quahog, Peter Griffin is determined to enjoy every bit of the celebration. Unfortunately, his talent for making terrible decisions threatens to turn the holiday into a complete disaster. Between bizarre encounters, outrageous antics, and unexpected twists, the Griffin family’s night quickly gets out of hand.
Lois attempts to keep everyone in line, while Stewie and Brian contribute their own questionable ideas to the chaos. The result is a Halloween adventure packed with the irreverent jokes and unpredictable comedy that make Family Guy stand out.
The Family Guy Halloween Special is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+. Watch the full episode today!
